Shown as ‘Upcoming’ until 30 minutes after the due time, then as ‘Missed’ if there is still no record.

Every dose whose due time has passed counts in the denominator, including skipped and missed ones. Doses that are not due yet (tomorrow onward, or later today) are left out of both numbers, even if you marked them as taken early. If there is nothing to count, N/A is shown. Percentages are rounded. Missed doses are never changed to skipped automatically.

MediCheck stores your account and medication records only on this device (Room database), with no server. Reminders go off as real Android notifications at the set times, and every feature works without the internet. Family sharing and add-by-photo are concept screens only, and the app does not recommend doses.
